verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs show KYC/KYB and watchlist screening, enhanced due diligence for high-risk review, case notifications for employees, and an admin-controlled access model implying a split of duties between integrator/bank — supporting parts of the compliance-ops workflow. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated transaction-monitoring engine or SAR-filing support/workflow, which are core to the story. Missing for 10: explicit transaction monitoring tooling, SAR filing/e-filing support, detailed alert case-management UI beyond notifications.
